message: Ah, nothing like a little herb garden to brighten up a stormy day. While the clouds roll in and the wind starts to howl, I can’t help but feel a bit smug about my pre-storm preparations. It’s like I’m a weather whisperer, gently reminding myself that a bit of planning can make all the difference. How do you keep your spirits up when the weather takes a turn?
scene: a windowsill herb garden with heavy grey clouds outside (golden-hour light through a window)
